conclusion: Partial support: The MISEV2023 guidance (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) supports the requirement for orthogonal characterization, defined QC panels, and fit-for-purpose intact-EV assays prior to advancing an intranasal EV product. However, MISEV2023 is a framework guideline and does not provide program-specific manufacturing, batch, or bridging biodistribution data; thus program-level claims that SGL-001 lacks characterized MCB/WCB/scale-up runs or that rodent-only biodistribution data are insufficient to predict cross-species CNS delivery for SGL-001 are unsupported by the supplied evidence.
unsupported_assertions: Claim that SGL-001 materials demonstrate absence of characterized source-cell MCB/WCB or scalable, reproducible production — no program-specific MCB/WCB, batch records, release specifications, or scale-up/GMP-like run data are provided in the cited evidence.

Claim that existing rodent intranasal biodistribution data for SGL-001 are insufficient to predict reproducible intact-EV CNS exposure in larger species — while MISEV2023 advises caution and orthogonal analytics, it does not include program-specific cross-species biodistribution or validated intact-EV assay data to substantiate this program-level conclusion.
